 Order
& CM APPL. 23995/2023 -Delay 8 days (RF).
1. These are applications filed by the appellant seeking condonation of 46 days delay in filing and 8 days delay in re-filing the appeal.
2. Issue notice.
Learned counsel for the respondent no.3, the only contesting respondent, accepts notice and does not oppose the applications.
3. The applications are, accordingly, for the reasons stated therein allowed.
Consequently, the delay of 46 days in filing and 8 days in re-filing the appeal is condoned.
4. The applications stand disposed of.

5. The present appeal preferred by the claimant under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act seeks enhancement of compensation awarded by the learned Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal vide its award dated 15.11.2022.
6. Issue notice.
Learned counsel for the respondent no.3 accepts notice.

7. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that taking into account that no recovery rights have been granted under the impugned award, no notice is required to be issued to the respondent nos.1 & 2.
8.
Pleadings in the matter are, therefore, treated as complete.
